name: Cherry-pink skin, almond smell
text: The body has a cherry-pink flush and there is a faint smell of bitter almonds about the mouth. Not the look of a heart attack.

name: The brandy, not the tonic
text: Reagent B turns Prussian blue in the decanter brandy and in the dregs of the glass. The tonic and the coffee test clean.

name: Bolted from inside
text: The office bolt was thrown from inside. The key is in Pryce's pocket. The window is barred and the bars are sound.

name: The music box
text: A child's music box sits on the desk, recently wound. Nothing else in the office is a child's. It is not Pryce's.

name: The original 1931 forecast
text: The original weather forecast for the Marigold's last flight, November 1931: storm warning, gusts to 42. It was never filed.

name: Torque slip, engine #2
text: A torque slip for the Marigold's number two engine, signed 'A. Brennan', dated the morning of the flight.

name: Meridian payment ledger
text: Payments from Meridian Air to C. Pryce, December 1931 to March 1932. No services described.

name: The unsent letter
text: Half-burnt, in Pryce's hand: '...tomorrow I end the silence. Forgive me, my girl...'

name: The forged forecast
text: The 'official' 1931 forecast was altered: different ink, an erased 42, a different carbon, a clipped signature. Its broken letter 'e' matches Tamsin Quill's typewriter.

name: The lifted rug corner
text: One corner of the office rug is turned up, and the line of dust along the floorboards is broken beneath it.

name: A seam under the rug
text: When the latch clicks, a square seam in the floorboards under the rug shifts. It is a trapdoor.

name: The unfired revolver
text: Pryce's revolver in the desk drawer: all six chambers loaded, barrel clean. It has not been fired.

name: The blotter impression
text: Pressed into the blotter in Pryce's heavy hand: 'ZÜRICH 0500 / 2 PASS.'

name: The calendar
text: On the office calendar, Saturday 18 November is circled twice. Beside it: 'END IT'.

name: The photograph caption
text: The framed photograph on the office wall: a young woman with bright hair, laughing. The caption reads 'Clementine, 19'.

name: The stopped watch
text: Pryce's pocket watch has stopped at 3:17. It has not been wound in a long time, on purpose.

name: The missing sedatives
text: Dr. Lindqvist's bag is short of morphine and chloral hydrate, in doses far larger than a night's sleep would need.

name: Billie's scarred fingertips
text: Captain Strand's fingertips are burn-scarred and ridge-less, from a 1929 crash. Her hand is broad.

name: The Trimotor's cockpit
text: Oil-stained flight gloves, the magneto switches left ON, the cockpit glass wiped. Someone tried to start the Trimotor in the night.

name: The forged contract
text: A torn Meridian contract with a signature page that does not match the others: the signature is a copy.

name: Vivienne's torn letter
text: On cream laid paper, to Julian: 'By Saturday we shall be free of him.'

name: Tamsin's ledger
text: Decoded: 'PAID 200 MONTHLY W/R 31 STORM FALSE.' Two years of payments from Pryce to Tamsin Quill.

name: The reset lever
text: The generator was tripped by lightning (the arrestor is scorched). The reset lever smells of soldering flux and carries radio grease: a radio man's hands, not a mechanic's.

name: Two cups, two plates
text: On the drying rack in the quarters kitchen, every night: two cups, two plates. The cook eats with the others.

name: A small woman's coat
text: Hidden behind the crates: a small woman's wool coat, moth-nibbled, mended at the cuffs.

name: The telegram's hitch
text: The telegram that brought you here was sent with Hobbs's little hitch on the Q, but slower and perfectly even, like someone who learned by listening.

name: The Marigold's last call
text: Hobbs's 1931 log transcribes the Marigold's last radio call. Behind the pilot, a young woman's voice.

name: The aerial photographs
text: Developed survey negatives of Raven Ridge, 1931: truck tracks reaching the wreck hours before the rescue party, and a drag trail from the wreck to the truck.

name: The cyanide jar
text: On the darkroom storeroom shelf, the potassium cyanide jar is light by one scoop. The shelf behind it is scuffed.

name: The small scarred print
text: On the decanter and the music box: the same small, narrow print with scarred, ridge-less pads. It matches no one at dinner.

name: Hobbs's tapping
text: Hobbs: 'Someone's been listening to my wires for two years. Tapping back, some nights.'

name: Body not recovered
text: A 1931 newspaper: 'Body of Clementine Pryce not recovered.' Six on the manifest, five death certificates.

name: Mrs. E. Marsh's prescriptions
text: Lindqvist's prescription pad: dressings and burn salve, sent to a 'Mrs. E. Marsh', Sable Flat post box, every month for two years.

name: Ox's supply order
text: A supply order in Ox's hand: hair ribbons, thread, stockings.

name: One ration over
text: The provisioning ledger: one ration more than there are mouths, every day for two years.

name: The note under the door
text: Slid under the office door: 'Pay by Saturday or the world learns about the Marigold.'

name: The scratched vent
text: The office floor vent has fresh scratches, and its screws are cleaner than any others in the room.

name: The beacon keeper's log
text: From the keeper's box: 'A lamp lit at the hangar floor vent every night at ten, for two years.'

name: The cracked mount
text: Dye test on the Marigold's number two engine mount: a jagged, branching crack. Tagged in Ox's hand. The 1931 crash was preventable.

name: Thirty-eight gallons
text: Fuel tank C, which feeds the Trimotor, lost 38 gallons overnight. Someone ran its engines.

name: The Waco's fuel cap
text: The Waco's fuel cap has been loosened, and it carries a greasy thumb smear.
